artworks.title: Roberto, Cardinal Bellarminus
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the waist up, seated with his body turned slightly to the right. He has his right hand over his chest and his left hand appears to be writing or gesturing towards an open book in front of him. The man has a high forehead, a receding hairline, and a neatly trimmed beard. His facial expression is serious. His hair is closely cropped. He is dressed in a robe with a high collar and buttons down the front. Surrounding him is a dark textured background, with a radiant emblem featuring the initials "IHS" and a cross above it to the upper right of his head. The setting includes an open book and a writing instrument on a table before him.

artworks.title: Bernhard, Abbot of the Monastery of Saint Udalric and Afra in Augsburg
artworks.artist: Bartholomaus Kilian after Johann Heinrich Schoenfeld
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, facing the viewer with his hands clasped in front of him. He is holding a string of beads in one hand and a book in the other. The man has aged facial features, with noticeable lines and a serious expression. He has a prominent forehead, a receding hairline, and neatly groomed hair on the sides. He is wearing a high-collared robe. The background includes an oval frame with Latin text, emblems, coats of arms, and other designs. The overall tone is formal and classical, focusing on the subject's serious demeanor.

artworks.title: Philip, Comte de Bethune
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man. He has a narrow face with deep-set eyes, a mustache, and a pointed goatee. His hair is styled in tight curls, and he is wearing an elaborate cloak with a large ruff around his neck. The man is holding a star-shaped object in his right hand. The background is plain and textured.

artworks.title: Jerome van Beverningk
artworks.description: The image shows a man with long, curly hair, facing slightly to his right but looking at the viewer head-on. He has a long face with a prominent nose and soft expression. He is wearing a dark garment with an ornate cravat featuring intricate patterns. The background includes an oval frame with decorative elements, within an elaborate rectangular frame. Latin text is inscribed along the oval frame and beneath the portrait. The image contains detailed engravings, an emblem with animal figures, and additional Latin text under the portrait.

artworks.title: Dr. Henry Blackwood, Jr.
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a bust portrait of a man within an oval frame. The man is posed slightly turned to his left, gazing directly at the viewer. His facial features include a prominent brow, deeply set eyes, a mustache, and a pointed beard. His hair is wavy, medium length, and appears tousled. He is wearing a formal outfit with a high, ruffled collar and a doublet with puffed sleeves and decorative stitching. The garment is adorned with buttons down the front. The design is framed by Latin text within the oval border. The background has fine vertical lines, and the lower part of the image features a rectangular area for additional text or inscriptions. The etching style is detailed, creating a textured effect on the clothing and hair.

artworks.title: Vincent le Blanc of Marseilles
artworks.description: The image shows a man in historical attire standing with one hand on his hip and the other holding a walking stick. He has facial hair, wears a hat with feathers, a detailed tunic, knee-length breeches, and tall boots. The background displays a landscape with hills and a town or fort in the distance. Text at the bottom identifies him as "The famous Traveller Vincent le Blanc of Marseilles."

artworks.title: Jean Jacques Boissard
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing the profile of a man from the shoulders up. He is positioned facing to the right and depicted with a side view of his facial features, which include a prominent nose, short curly hair, and a mustache. The man's hair appears to be closely cropped. He is wearing a garment with a fur collar and a vest, and his upper body is draped with a cloak that has detailed folds and textures. The background of the image is intricate, featuring ornate scrollwork and floral designs that frame the portrait. The border includes text specifying the name "IANUS IACOBVS VESYNTINUS" and the creator “BOISSARDUS.”

artworks.title: Jean Jacques Boissard
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile portrait of a man from the chest upwards. He has a distinctive nose, a curly beard, and curly hair framing his face. The man is depicted in detailed attire, with a fur-trimmed cloak over a richly detailed outfit. The man appears older and mature, with no visible jewelry or objects. The background features an oval frame with inscriptions around it reading "IANUS IACOBUS BOISSARDUS VESVNTINVS Æ AET LXIX."

artworks.title: Hans Bol
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with facial hair and short hair. He wears historical attire with a ruffled collar and puffed sleeves. The portrait is in an oval frame with an inscription "IOANNES BOLLIVS" and other Latin text with Roman numerals. Surrounding the portrait are allegorical figures, including cherubs, a globe, winged female figures, floral motifs, and a skull with wings and crossbones. The background has detailed carvings and designs.

artworks.title: Rev. Robert Bolton
artworks.medium: engraving; with letters on second sheet pasted below the engraving
artworks.description: The artwork features a head-and-shoulders portrait of an older man facing slightly to the right. He has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, a full beard and mustache, and combed-back hair. He wears a dark-buttoned coat and a white ruffled collar. The portrait is framed within an oval with ornate designs including pillars, scrolls, and a collection of fruit. Above him are an inkwell with a quill and a book. The background is intricately decorated with fine lines. At the bottom is a Latin inscription on a scroll.

artworks.title: Everhard Bornaeus
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, positioned facing slightly to the right while looking directly at the viewer. His facial features include a high forehead, a slightly downturned mouth, and thin lips, with a mostly bald head and longer hair on the sides extending to his ears. He is wearing a dark, full-sleeved robe with a white collar and intricate detailing on the cuffs. His left hand is holding a closed book, and his right hand is gesturing. The background is a plain, textured surface. Below the portrait, there is ornate text featuring the name "EVERHARDUS BORNÆUS" and additional text detailing his positions and years in a decorative frame with cherubs at each end.

artworks.title: Jacob Bornonius
artworks.artist: Attributed to Pieter van den Berge
artworks.description: The image is a detailed engraving featuring the head and shoulders of a bearded man in an ornate oval frame. The man is positioned centrally, facing slightly to his right with a focused expression. His features include a prominent forehead, expressive eyes, and a full beard. He has closely cropped hair and wears historical clothing with a fur-lined collar. The frame around the portrait is adorned with intricate designs, including scrollwork, emblems, and cherubic figures. Two statuesque figures in classical attire flank the oval, each wielding weapons and wearing ornate armor. The background outside the frame contains additional ornaments and inscriptions in different languages.

artworks.title: Anthony Bourbon, Count Mouretan
artworks.artist: Pieter de Bailliu after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a three-quarter-length portrait. He is slightly turned to his left with his left hand on his waist and his right hand on the hilt of a sword at his side. The man has distinct facial features including a mustache and goatee. His hair is curly and reaches his neck. He wears a richly adorned garment with a pattern, lace collar, and full sleeves with lace cuffs. The background features a detailed drapery on the right side. The bottom of the image likely contains descriptive text.

artworks.title: Charlotte of Bourbon
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman within an ornate oval frame. She is standing with her body slightly turned, hands resting on a cloth-draped table. Her face is captured in profile with distinct features and a serene expression. She has styled hair and wears a high collar, known as a ruff. The woman is dressed in a detailed gown with patterns, embroidery, and ornate sleeves. She wears visible jewelry around her neck. The background features Renaissance-style motifs, scrollwork, floral designs, allegorical illustrations, and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Charlotte of Bourbon
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length depiction of a woman standing with her body slightly angled to the right, gazing forward. She has an elaborate hairstyle, with her hair styled up, and is wearing an ornate dress with a ruffled collar. The woman is adorned with a necklace and has her hands carefully placed, with one hand resting on a table holding books and fabric. The setting is framed within an oval shape bordered by a classical design motif, including cherubs, floral arrangements, and possibly heraldic symbols. The background is detailed with classical figures and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Charlotte of Bourbon
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a woman's upper-body portrait. She is standing in a frontal position, looking slightly to her left. The woman has a high lace ruff, neatly arranged hair, and is wearing an intricately patterned garment with ornamental details. Her hands are placed on a table with objects on it. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame with intricate designs. The background features ornamental engravings, allegorical figures, and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Catherine de Bourbon
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a woman, capturing her from the shoulders up. She is positioned facing slightly to the right, with her head turned towards the viewer. Her facial features include a high forehead, narrow eyes, a long nose, and a small mouth. Her hair is styled in elaborately curled waves, gathered into an updo adorned with a decorative ornament at the top. She is wearing a high, pleated ruff around her neck, and her dress is richly decorated with intricate patterns featuring cross motifs and ornamental designs, along with rows of ornamentation that resemble pearls. Her attire is luxurious and detailed, suggesting a high status. She also has drop earrings and a large, conspicuous brooch on her chest. The background of the image is plain, emphasizing the ornate details of her attire and the rigidity of her posture. Around the portrait is an oval frame with text encircling it.

artworks.title: Catherine de Bourbon
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is facing slightly to her right, with her face turned towards the viewer. Her features include pronounced eyebrows and slightly parted lips. She has curly hair pulled up and adorned with an ornate headpiece. The woman is wearing a detailed dress with a high lace ruff around her neck, embellished with pearls and intricate patterns. Her sleeves also feature intricate designs and pearls. She wears an earring on one ear. The background is a densely cross-hatched oval frame with inscribed text around the edge and below the portrait. The portrait conveys a regal context.

artworks.title: Catherine of Bourbon, Sister of Henry IV
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait showing the upper body of a woman, identified as Catherine de Bourbon. She is positioned facing forward, with her head slightly turned to her right. Her facial features include a high forehead and fine eyebrows, and she has a modest, composed expression. Her hair is styled in an ornate fashion typical of the period, with a large, rounded puff encircling her head. The woman is dressed in elaborate clothing, characterized by a high, pleated ruff around her neck and a richly detailed dress adorned with intricate patterns and pearls. She appears to be wearing several strands of pearls across her chest as part of her attire. The surrounding setting is an intricately designed oval border containing text. The background of the portrait is filled with elaborate cross-hatching, creating a textured appearance, and the border frame includes her name. Below the portrait is a section of text in French.

artworks.title: Catherine de Bourbon
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman from the torso up within an oval frame. She is facing slightly to her right, with delicate facial features, a high forehead, arched eyebrows, and a composed expression. Her hairstyle is an elaborate updo with a decorative element. She wears a Renaissance-style dress with a lace ruff, puffed sleeves, and intricate embroidery. Adornments include a pearl necklace and a brooch with a cross. She holds an object in her right hand, resting on her lap. The background features a herringbone pattern, with an inscription reading "Catherine de Bourbon" and decorative scrollwork including the artist's signature.

artworks.title: Eleanora, Princess of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter length portrait of a woman seated. She is positioned slightly turned to her right, with her left arm resting on a surface and her right hand holding a handkerchief. Her facial features are defined with a strong gaze, and she has a high hairstyle adorned with jewelry, such as a decorative comb or pin. She wears a lavish dress with intricate embroidery and an elaborate lace ruff around her shoulders, complementing her opulent attire. The dress is embellished with pearls and floral patterns, and she is adorned with long pearl necklaces and earrings. Her wrists are adorned with bracelets. Behind her, there is a backdrop with draped fabric.

artworks.title: Elizabeth de Bourbon
artworks.description: The image depicts a young child standing upright. The child has a round face, large eyes, a small mouth, and voluminous hair styled with a headband or crown. They wear an intricate gown with a fitted bodice, puffy sleeves, and a full skirt. The gown is embellished with lace, a detailed belt, and possibly brocade patterns. The child holds a tethered bird of prey on their left hand. Surrounding them is a ornate circular frame, with parted curtains in the background. The overall background has a textured horizontal line pattern.

artworks.title: Francois de Bourbon, First Prince of Conti, son of Louis I
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man in an ornate illustration style. He is facing forward but slightly angled to his left, gazing directly at the viewer. The man has sharp facial features, a neatly styled beard and mustache, short wavy hair brushed back from his forehead, and is wearing elaborate armor with decorative elements and a cloak. The background features an intricate pattern within an oval border framing the figure. Text near the border reads "FRANCOIS DE BOURBON PRINCE DE CONTY," with additional context in elegant script below the image.

artworks.title: Henry II de Bourbon, Prince de Conde
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a young boy facing forward. He has a round face with soft features and curly hair styled upward. He wears a richly adorned outfit with a high, ruffled collar. The boy is captured in a confident posture with one hand on his hip. The portrait is encased in an ornate oval border with inscriptions. The background consists of intricate line work. The bottom of the image contains French text in a classical script style.
